purpose: Machine-readable patterns that survived historical failure pressure or have current bounded evidence. Surviving pattern != whole-system success.
promotion_rule: Promote only at the exact scope supported by source/test/runtime evidence.

patterns.why_it_survives: Historical Frankenstein needed persistent personality, memory, goals, reward logs, project state and spatial/world state; the current owner target keeps durable exact information in the persistent database substrate rather than reconstructing it through inference.
patterns.boundary: Does not prove every current DB schema or persistence implementation is optimal.

patterns.surviving_principle: Resolver miss, ambiguity, low confidence, stale epoch or missing canonical row binding blocks graph/assembly ignition.
patterns.why_it_survives: Current source binds logical resolution to current UnifiedDB row identity and marks the result derived, ASSEMBLY_CONTEXT_ONLY and not a persistent second store.
patterns.boundary: Source presence is not integrated runtime acceptance or downstream-utility proof.
patterns.next_discriminator: Fixed-query utility/contamination benchmark against simpler retrieval baselines under exact current runtime identity.

patterns.surviving_principle: Canonical state remains exact while prompt/context serialization is treated as a separately measurable control surface.
patterns.why_it_survives: Historical hard-coded architecture text and rich room prose changed model behavior without changing the underlying intended state.
patterns.boundary: The best projection format remains empirical.

patterns.surviving_principle: LCME/Titan memory represented claims, time-weighted confidence and counter-hypotheses instead of flattening everything into facts.
patterns.why_it_survives: It is compatible with current evidence law that memory is not observation and unresolved alternatives must remain distinguishable.
patterns.boundary: Historical implementation does not prove current UnifiedDB equivalence or retrieval quality.

patterns.surviving_principle: Salience-bearing publish/subscribe, bounded history and subscriber failure isolation are reusable coordination primitives.
patterns.why_it_survives: The archaeology index preserves the historical workspace bus as a precursor while refusing to inflate it into full GWT evidence.
patterns.boundary: No coalition competition, causal uptake or re-entry credit follows automatically.

patterns.surviving_principle: Reflection must alter later control and terminate into ACT, ASK, WAIT or re-observation instead of recursing indefinitely.
patterns.why_it_survives: Historical rumination/fixation pressure and external reflection-agent research motivate bounded feedback artifacts tied to later measurable behavior.
patterns.boundary: External Reflexion results do not prove the project's reflection subsystem adds unique causal value.
patterns.next_discriminator: Lesion explicit reflection under matched retrieval, feedback, token and action budgets.

patterns.surviving_principle: N is a runtime parameter; GRID10 is a benchmark configuration, not the architecture definition.
patterns.why_it_survives: The owner target explicitly permits 10, 20 or other module counts and requires the same cognitive process to survive grid-size changes.
patterns.boundary: Variable-N equivalence and scaling remain runtime research questions.

patterns.surviving_principle: The approximately-0.8B grid is a cognitive-process substrate around Claude Code, not a replacement for the strong model/tool/code partner.
patterns.why_it_survives: It separates high-capability code/tool work from reusable low-cost cognitive-process specialization.
patterns.boundary: Communication benefit, specialization quality and end-to-end Zero equivalence remain unproven.

patterns.surviving_principle: A shared state/vector only earns coordination credit if transfer can be shown to alter later cognition at an actually exposed interface.
patterns.why_it_survives: Current source keeps branch preservation, broadcast/uptake/re-entry and evidence-conditioned collapse as gates instead of inferring causality from coherence.
patterns.boundary: No hidden-state or activation access to Claude Code may be claimed without direct support.

patterns.surviving_principle: Recurrence or majority does not mint truth; preserve unresolved alternatives until an evidence-bearing discriminator supports collapse.
patterns.why_it_survives: It guards against consensus/repetition Goodharting and premature certainty.
patterns.boundary: Decision-quality benefit on full tasks remains to be measured.

patterns.surviving_principle: Prefer topology-specific measurement over generic threading intuition.
patterns.why_it_survives: On the measured 4-process/4-vCPU topology, 1 thread/process averaged 8.3197 s/call, 2 threads averaged 23.1806 s/call, and 4 threads completed no samples within timeouts.
patterns.boundary: Does not promote Physical GRID10, HCU, canonical semantics or another topology.

patterns.surviving_principle: Keep implemented, executed, reported-success, measured, replicated, causally-supported, owner-observation, negative and superseded evidence distinct.
patterns.why_it_survives: The archaeology pipeline prevents hindsight and prose consensus from rewriting what was actually implemented or measured.
patterns.boundary: Method quality does not fill missing factual evidence.

patterns.surviving_principle: Classify root entries and dependency candidates before moving files; UNKNOWN remains blocked.
patterns.why_it_survives: It advances the human-legible root target without breaking boot files, workflows or canonical paths by cosmetic reorganization.
patterns.boundary: Literal Git references are dependency candidates, not runtime-consumption proof.

patterns.surviving_principle: Use ReAct, Reflexion, activation engineering, GWT/GNW, SQLite WAL and CUDA Unified Memory to design tests/analogies without laundering external results into project runtime credit.
patterns.why_it_survives: It imports useful methods while preserving project-specific causal evidence requirements.
